issue.title: Residual just test-visual golden drift: 29 PNG snapshots fail on clean master after sase-up's chrome-shift fix
issue.description:
`just test-visual` fails 29 of ~855 PNG goldens on a clean master tree (HEAD 457041681,
2026-09-05), unrelated to any pending change. Confirmed by stashing all local diffs
(the plans/202609/starting_agents_count_only.md fix) and re-running the identical
failing subset against clean master: the same 27 of the sampled 29 tests fail
byte-for-byte with no diff applied, with tiny changed-pixel ratios (roughly 0.06%-1.8%
changed pixels per golden), unlike the uniform 5181-pixel one-row chrome shift that
sase-up documented on 2026-08-27 (360/840 failing then). The failure count has since
dropped from 360 to 29, so sase-up's chrome-shift cause looks at least partly fixed,
but a smaller residual corpus of per-golden pixel drift remains and needs its own
investigation (font/renderer version drift is the leading suspect, since diffs are
small and vary per golden rather than sharing one fixed pixel count).

Representative failing nodes observed on 2026-09-05:

- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_artifacts_agents.py::test_artifacts_agents_filter_parse_error_png_snapshot
- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_clan_panel.py::test_epic_clan_panel_png_snapshots
- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_clan_panel.py::test_swarm_clan_panel_png_snapshots
- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_preview_panel.py::test_preview_panel_active_search_png_snapshot
- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_axe.py::test_axe_lumberjack_tree_png_snapshot
- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_update_panel.py::test_update_panel_pending_png_snapshot
- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_link_reveal_chip.py::test_beads_link_reveal_chip_png_snapshots

Full 29-test list is in the `just test-visual` run captured in monitor npeatr4x3gms
(family 0gf) on this host, dated 2026-09-05.

Two of the originally-reported 29 (`config_center_plugins_not_uv_tool` and
`agents_external_repo_diff_file_panel`) passed on rerun, consistent with additional
flakiness layered on top of the deterministic subset -- worth separating flaky vs.
deterministic failures during triage.

Reproduce:

    just test-visual
    # inspect .pytest_cache/sase-visual/<node>/<golden>/{summary.txt,diff.png}

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Reproduced deterministically by stashing all local changes and re-running the identical failing subset against clean master HEAD 457041681: the same 27 of 29 sampled tests fail again with matching diff artifacts, and the pending local diff (plans/202609/starting_agents_count_only.md) does not touch any of the failing goldens' subsystems.

evidence.note: PROPOSED BY phase sase-xy.4.2 note #1: its 2026-09-07 just test-visual run on clean landed pager-link corrections reported 32 ACE PNG test failures across Agents/Models/Artifacts/AXE, while all six pager labeled-document goldens passed. The retained .pytest_cache/sase-visual evidence contains 29 failing snapshot cases, matching this task's residual broad golden-drift class; two are missing artifact_links_panel_needs_reveal_row goldens and the remaining 27 are mismatches. The event-loop-context change touches pager context plumbing and its pager goldens are green, so this is independent reproduction/impact evidence, not work caused by sase-xy.4.

Independent reproduction on 2026-09-09 at master HEAD cef06cdca during the sase-y5.12 landing gate: `just check-full && just test-visual` gave 35 failed / 862 passed. Re-running only those 35 node IDs in isolation gave 33 failed / 2 passed, so the deterministic residue has grown from 29 to 33 and two nodes (test_models_panel_usage_120_columns_png_snapshot, test_agents_context_zoom_modal_png_snapshot) are separate convergence flakes layered on top, matching the flaky-vs-deterministic split this bead already predicted.

CAUSE EVIDENCE THAT REDIRECTS TRIAGE: this is not font/renderer version drift. I inspected the actual/expected artifacts and the diffs are semantic content changes, whole text rows present in one image and absent in the other, from rendering commits that never rebaselined their goldens. Three confirmed so far:

- The 7 axe_* goldens are missing the `Spawns/min: / No-op: / Skipped:` metadata row that 9ed0f11b7 "feat(axe): add idle-host perf counters, budgets, and status overlay" (bead sase-wn.10, 2026-09-05) added to _axe_dashboard_output.py. The golden was never regenerated.
- update_panel_pending_120x40 and update_panel_unchecked_120x40 still show the `a/A Agents - Import agent hoods your other machines published` option and `Everything: 8 available`; current code renders 6 because 61d72860a "Remove ACE agents-sync import surfaces" (bead sase-ws.1, 2026-09-04) deleted the import leg. `grep -rn "Import agent hoods" src/` returns nothing, so these two goldens cannot pass on any current tree.
- models_panel_runner_limit_action_120x40 still reads `Explicit %wait(runners=N)`; current code renders `%queue(runners=N)` after ff6271e53 "chore(xprompt): require queue directive core support" (bead sase-yj.4).

None of sase-wn, sase-ws, or sase-yj is an in-progress epic, so there is no active epic to route these back to; they are standing rebaseline debt of exactly the class sase-r5 described. Because the causes are per-commit content changes rather than one shared drift, a blanket `--sase-update-visual-snapshots` would silently accept whatever each of those landings changed; each golden needs its diff read before it is accepted.

NOT ALL 33 ARE GOLDEN DRIFT: test_agents_task_bead_notes_png_snapshot fails on a hard `assert "Size:" in svg_plain` and never reaches the PNG comparison at all. Filed separately as its own ci task and linked to this bead.

PROOF THESE ARE UNRELATED TO THE TREE UNDER TEST: I reverted the sase-y5.12 epic's entire src/ diff (`git checkout 4068437a2 -- src/`, the only non-memory commits in that range being the epic's own d165fbbaa and cef06cdca) and re-ran the same 33 node IDs. All 33 failed identically against pre-epic source, so none of them is caused by the usage-context surface.

IMPACT: `just test-visual` is not part of `just check` or `just check-full`, so this lane stays red without blocking any landing; it cost this landing a 29m36s monitored gate run and a full triage pass to establish that none of the 35 failures were the epic's.

Reproduce: `just test-visual` then inspect .pytest_cache/sase-visual/<node>/<golden>/{summary.txt,diff.png,actual.png,expected.png}.
